name: AddCircle.equivIco
type: {𝕜 : Type u} → [AddCommGroup 𝕜] → (p : 𝕜) → [LinearOrder 𝕜] → [IsOrderedAddMonoid 𝕜] → [Fact (0 < p)] → (a : 𝕜) → [Archimedean 𝕜] → AddCircle p ≃ Set.Ico a (a + p)
provides: Selects the unique real representative in a specified half-open interval of one positive period; this is an equivalence of types, not a homeomorphism with the usual interval topology.

name: AddCircle.norm_eq
type: (p : ℝ) → {x : ℝ} → ‖(x : AddCircle p)‖ = |x - Int.round (p⁻¹ * x) * p|
provides: Computes the quotient-circle norm by subtracting a nearest integer multiple of its period, giving the minimum absolute displacement.
